proposition: Coach-application mechanic model (Chinese-community DP tool, DLS26China): technical coaches grant +1/+2/+3 stat points depending on rarity (Common/White/Rare/Blue/Legendary/Gold = +1/+2/+3). Stat cap is 100; capped stats leave the pool. For TECHNICAL coaches the observed weights are CON weight 2, PAS/SHO/TKL weight 1 each (defender-focused tool). Over-capacity applications produce fractional stat gain (gainedStat = remaining_cap / sumWeight). The target-stat strategy is a combinatorial gamble, not directed training. proposition: DLS26 OVR is computed as a linear weighted sum of the 8 attributes plus a constant. Best-fit across 2,255 non-GK base cards gives: OVR ≈ 1.86 + 0.225·CON + 0.164·STR + 0.144·SPE + 0.137·ACC + 0.107·PAS + 0.100·SHO + 0.099·TAC + 0.055·STA (MAE 0.37, RMSE 0.46 on base; MAE 0.70 cross-validated on Larrycr7aaaa promo outfield cards). Control (CON) is the highest-weighted attribute; Stamina (STA) is the lowest. For GKs, the two highest weights (≈0.475 each) map onto the columns labelled GKH and GKR in promo data. Position-specific re-weighting is small (top-N average MAE by position was 0.68–1.1 with varying N, vs 0.37 for the single global linear model), implying no strong position-specific OVR curve.
